market_name: Will 7 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the shift in the 7-cut probability coincides with a move in 2y/10y Treasury yields and Fed funds futures; confirm it is not idiosyncratic thin-market noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move to SOFR/Fed funds futures repricing to see if the rates complex confirms the dovish signal.
time_plan.2h: Look for a macro catalyst (weak data, financial stress, geopolitical shock) that would justify aggressive easing expectations.
time_plan.6h: Re-assess whether TLT gains held; check for Fed speaker pushback or hawkish repricing.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate whether the dovish repricing persisted into the close and whether rate-cut odds across strikes (3,4,5 cuts) moved consistently.

predictions.reasoning: A market on '7 Fed rate cuts in 2026' pricing higher implies expectations of aggressive monetary easing, typically tied to a growth scare or recession. A sharp rise in the implied probability of 7 cuts would signal the market discounting a much lower policy rate path, pulling front-end and duration yields down and lifting long-duration Treasury prices. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for falling rate expectations.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify DXY direction and real-yield proxies; a weaker dollar and falling reals would corroborate a gold-positive read.
time_plan.1h: Check whether gold move tracks the rates repricing or is driven by separate risk-off/geopolitical flow.
time_plan.2h: Scan for any conflict or macro headline consistent with the market's military_conflict tagging that would drive a haven bid.
time_plan.6h: Confirm gold's move persists and is not a fade of an intraday spike.
time_plan.12h: Assess whether the dovish + haven narrative held into the close; reconcile with dollar and Treasury moves.

predictions.reasoning: An escalation in the probability of 7 rate cuts implies deeper anticipated easing and lower real yields, which is historically supportive for gold. A dovish/recessionary signal also carries a safe-haven bid, especially given the market's tagged military_conflict topic, which could add a geopolitical risk premium. Gold benefits from both channels, though the linkage is noisier than for Treasuries.

evidence_used: Market question implies an extreme dovish scenario (7 x 25bp cuts in 2026)
Rate-cut expectations are a primary driver of Treasury duration, the dollar, and gold
Early-resolution mechanics mean the 7-cut strike is a tail scenario tied to recession/emergency action
Topic tag references military_conflict, hinting at possible geopolitical risk overlay
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradability threshold is far above realistic 12h moves for these liquid ETFs; neither prediction is 'tradable' by that bar
Prediction-market probability for a 2026 tail strike may be illiquid and noisy, weakening any leakage signal
Direction depends on whether a probability rise reflects genuine macro news versus low-volume repricing
Fed easing expectations may already be fully public via Fed funds futures, leaving no informational edge

llm_justification.summary: The market asks whether the Fed delivers 7 rate cuts (175bp) in 2026 — an extreme dovish tail scenario implying recession or emergency easing. If its implied probability rises sharply, the cleanest public-market implications are higher long-duration Treasury prices (TLT up) on lower rate expectations and higher gold (GLD up) on falling real yields plus a potential safe-haven bid. Both mappings are directionally sensible but modest in 12h magnitude, well below the 700bps tradable threshold, and carry meaningful noise from an illiquid tail-strike prediction market.
key_assumptions: A rise in the 7-cut probability reflects genuine dovish/recession repricing rather than thin-market noise
Rate-cut expectations transmit to Treasury duration and gold through the standard real-yield channel
The move is not already fully reflected in Fed funds futures and bond prices
failure_modes: The probability move is noise in an illiquid tail-strike market and no asset move follows
The easing expectation is already public via futures, so no leakage/edge exists
A dovish surprise could be equity-positive risk-on that lifts yields (bear-steepening), reversing the TLT thesis
Gold is a weak/noisy proxy that can decouple if the dollar strengthens on safe-haven flows
Expected magnitudes are far below the 700bps threshold, so nothing is actionable under the stated rule
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
